text:
maria: Heads-up: PR #8429 updates token projection for on-prem sidecar; might expose projected token to hostEnv in some VPC setups. pinging @olivia @sam for quick sec/privacy eyes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8429. TL;DR: switches to service account token path, adds mount at /var/run/redwood/token, and sets env SHARED_TOKEN=true. Would like quick OK before merge window at 17:00 PT.

devops-bot: Automated scan: potential secret-in-env flagged in changed files — https://scans.redwood/8429 :warning:

sam: Quick q — does this change the k8s projected token to hostPath or keep it as a projected volume? If hostPath we need to escalate. also, is there any KMS/HSM call path in this flow?

maria: It's projectedToken by default. We added a fallback for very old/legacy nodes where projection fails which writes to hostPath. Fallback is behind a feature flag. Snippet:```yaml
volumeMounts:
- name: token
  mountPath: /var/run/redwood/token
env:
- name: SHARED_TOKEN
  value: "true"
```

olivia: Privacy: If SHARED_TOKEN=true we need to ensure token TTL and scope are minimized. What SA scopes are used? also require audit logging + rotation plan before we enable any hostPath fallback.

lee: Also please update on-prem docs and include a quick smoke command for operators: `./scripts/smoke_onprem.sh --token-check`

jordan: I can do a quick code review + staging run. If we keep projection-only path, i'm fine. If fallback to hostPath remains, that should be opt-in only and require security L2 signoff.

maria: Agree — i'll remove the fallback and make it opt-in behind TOKEN_HOSTPATH=false; will push a patch in ~30m and update docs. thanks :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Deploy bot: FYI merge window for regular merges closes in ~2h. If you need a slotted merge after that, tag @oncall-release or file a merge request.

olivia: Once the patch is pushed i can re-review. please include the token scope diff and a sample of audit log entries in the PR description.

maria: Patch pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8433 with fallback removed + feature flag TOKEN_HOSTPATH=false + docs update. Ran local smoke tests (token mount + rotation). cc @sam @olivia

sam: Running k8s e2e in staging now (focus on token projection and rotation tests). :eyes:

jordan: LGTM pending one small nit about env var naming. If sam's staging e2e passes, we can merge to canary and run canary-batch ~50 hosts.

sam: Staging e2e passed — token rotation test OK, projected volume behaves as expected.

olivia: Privacy review: approved with one requirement — rotate tokens at least every 6 hours and document rotation/alerting. Added a short doc comment on the PR.

maria: Thanks all — merging into canary in 10m and will watch logs/tracing. Will file a post-deploy note in #incidents only if we see anomalies.
_meta: This thread is a short engineering coordination / sec-privacy PR ping about on-prem token projection fallback, feature-flagging, and merge timing. Messages are short and sequential per Slack thread style.
